g.text: May it be an evening star, shines down upon you.
但愿有一颗暮色之星，拂照着你。

g.text: As the ground is shaking, as silence seems to grow.
It is the faith in sight, the doubt that fades.
即使，地动山摇；即使，寂静疯涨。
眼中仅存信仰，怀疑逐渐消失。

g.text: The oldest and strongest emotion of mankind is fear.
And the oldest and strongest fear is fear of unknown.
人类最古老、最强烈的感情是恐惧。
而最古老、最强烈的恐惧，是对未知的恐惧。
